summary: Environment A direct-binary proof that Phase 24.1 (get_prepared_item_slide - real RenderedSlide rendering for the Live/Preview stage's queue strip) is genuinely compiled into this rebuilt installer, with zero functional regression to every prior-phase Rust symbol.
gitCommitNote: This is the source tree commit (Phase 24.1's own commit) the Phase 24.1 rebuild was performed against. Phase 24.1 touches apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs, apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs, apps/desktop/src/lib/commands.ts, apps/desktop/src/components/LiveChurchBrain.tsx, apps/desktop/src/components/servicereplay/ServiceReplay.tsx, apps/desktop/src/components/workspace/LivePreviewStage.tsx, apps/desktop/src/components/workspace/workspace.css, and adds docs/phase-24-1-audit.md. Phases 23 and 24 (the layout shell and the dual Live/Preview panel this phase extends) were both frontend-only and never triggered a Windows rebuild; this is the first rebuild since Phase 22 (gitCommit 3837816).
buildLog: ran directly in this session (not committed - ephemeral build log)

installer.ggmlTwoPassFixNote: First build attempt failed as expected on the known whisper-rs-sys ggml lib-name defect; the build script applied its established fix and the retry succeeded - the same harmless, unrelated build-toolchain quirk documented and handled identically in every prior whisper-enabled Windows rebuild this project has done.

symbolRegressionCheck.method: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings cip-desktop.exe | grep -c <symbol>, run against the extracted installer's main executable. Every tripwire from Phase 22's own baseline (the most recent prior rebuild) was re-checked; all matched exactly with zero deviation.
symbolRegressionCheck.tripwiresFromPriorPhasesDeviation: None. All 22 pre-existing tripwire symbols matched their Phase 22 baseline count exactly, including classify_model_size_tier (0 - already established in Phase 22's own evidence as expected optimizer inlining, not a regression) and retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context (1 - already established in Phase 22's own evidence as the new baseline after that phase's own benign inlining variance).

newTripwireThisPhase.note: 2 occurrences confirmed: the mangled Rust symbol (_ZN15cip_desktop_lib8commands23get_prepared_item_slide...) proving the command function itself is compiled in, plus its literal command-name string inside the generated Tauri invoke-handler dispatch table (visible directly adjacent to get_presentation_item and cancel_presentation in the extracted command-name string), proving it is actually registered and reachable from the frontend's invoke() call, not merely present as dead code.

renderContentStillPresent.note: cip_presentation_renderer::render_content's mangled symbol is present, confirming get_prepared_item_slide reuses the same single rendering pipeline display_presentation and get_presentation_display_state already call, not a second implementation.

frontendTextSearchLimitation: The frontend bundle is not searchable as plain strings inside cip-desktop.exe the same way Rust symbols are - the new queueSlides state/effect in LiveChurchBrain.tsx/ServiceReplay.tsx and LivePreviewStage.tsx's updated queue-card rendering were not independently string-searched, consistent with every prior phase's methodology. Frontend correctness rests on npm run typecheck's success, the full 303/303 frontend test pass (unchanged from Phase 24), and real-browser-engine visual verification with a mocked get_prepared_item_slide response (see docs/phase-24-1-audit.md) confirming the queue strip's cards render real wrapped body text and footer, not the prior raw-text approximation.
architecturalSafetyNotes: One new Tauri command (get_prepared_item_slide), zero new events, zero new migrations, zero schema changes.

get_prepared_item_slide never mutates PresentationItem status and has no effect on prepare_presentation, display_presentation, cancel_presentation, or any other presentation lifecycle command - it is a pure read + re-render, reusing render_content exactly as display_presentation and get_presentation_display_state already do.
Every other domain contract crate (core/bible, core/sermon, core/music, core/service) is entirely untouched.
Every prior-phase command and symbol remains present and unregressed - zero deviation across all 22 pre-existing tripwires, confirming this phase's addition did not disturb any prior gate or feature.
